exposure: Indications for Cesarean Delivery (non-reassuring fetal heart rate pattern, cephalopelvic disproportion)
cohort: The study included 422 women who underwent cesarean delivery in three selected health facilities in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with significant maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality, with specific factors like repeat CD, emergency CD, and antepartum hemorrhage linked to maternal complications, and nulliparity, hypertensive disorders, gestational age, APGAR score, and need for resuscitation linked to neonatal death.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery itself, particularly emergency and repeat CDs, was associated with significant maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality.
followup_time: 7 days after birth (or until discharge or death, whichever occurred first)
cross-section timing: Data collected between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2022
gest_age: Babies included were delivered after 28 weeks of gestation; gestational age was also identified as a factor associated with neonatal death.
